scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.contracts: uv run --project apps/api python scripts/export-openapi.py && pnpm --filter @folkverse/contracts generate
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @folkverse/web lint && uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api scripts/export-openapi.py
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @folkverse/web typecheck && uv run --project apps/api mypy --config-file apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api/src
scripts.data:liaoning:collect: uv run --project apps/api python -m folkverse.liaoning_inventory collect
scripts.data:liaoning:report: uv run --project apps/api python -m folkverse.liaoning_inventory report
scripts.benchmark:guide: uv run --project apps/api --extra embeddings python -m folkverse.guide_benchmark
